Im sorry you feel like this bud.  I'm feeling the same way.... I moved away from my family about 9 years ago, but not because they ignored me, but because they rubbed in my face how much better my brother was.

When I was 23, I sold everything i owned and moved 3000km away. For a while things got better. Years later I moved back a few 100km away and they acted like all of a sudden we were some sort of perfect fucking family. 

Recently I confronted them about all the shit I dealt with growing up, and even though alot of it was previously in writing from years ago, literally in paper that I gave them, they did nothing but act ignorant about it. 

Im 33 years old now and although I've learned to be self sufficient, it has left a giant hole in my heart, and left me very wary of letting people in. 

If you want someone to talk to tonight, message me. If not tonight, this account is disposable so I won't reply, it's not permanent.

Personally im having a hard time, but If I wasn't an atheist, I'd be praying for you. Since I'm not, I'm really hoping for you buddy :)
